name: home-bound-fresh-blade-third
elderweald-clearing-third
expression: async()=>{await __earthGpuRoute(18,6);const p=RealmWorldFoundations.preview(Realm.test.worldContext(),'earthlands');if(!p.ok)throw Error(p.error);const r=Realm.test.worldTravel(p.ticket);if(!r.ok)throw Error(r.error);const crossing=await __earthGpuClearCrossing();const route=await __earthGpuRoute(-70,-8);return{crossing,route,method:'Actual crossing defeat prerequisite is completed before root inspection; no payment or patrol claim'};}

name: root-pocket-live-encounter-third
expression: async()=>{document.querySelector('[data-rpg="camera"][data-id="adventure"]').click();await __earthGpuRoute(-148,-66);const e=Realm.state.earthExpedition,p=e.patrol.active;if(!p||p.run!==3||e.patrol.lastClaim!==2||!p.steps.includes('clear-crossing'))throw Error('Expected unpaid earned run3 with actual crossing defeat');const r=Realm.test.expeditionCommand('patrol-step',{quest:RealmEarthExpedition.patrol.id,run:p.run,priorClaim:e.patrol.lastClaim,step:'inspect-root'});if(!r.ok)throw Error(r.error);await __earthGpuRoute(-134,-68.9);Realm.test.view({yaw:.4,elevation:.25,distance:8});const d=Realm.diagnostics.adventure,actor=d.enemies.find(a=>a.id===RealmEarthExpedition.patrol.id+'-run-3-root');if(!actor||actor.hp<=0||d.tactics.auto||Realm.state.adventure.companion.bonded)throw Error('Expected live root actor, unbonded fixture and automatic attacks off');return{acceptedStep:r,actor,actors:d.enemies.length,hp:Realm.state.adventure.hp,method:'Actual accepted patrol root encounter; ordinary RAF; no health/position/actor/time grants or scaling; automatic attacks off'};}

name: root-pocket-live-encounter-diorama
expression: ()=>{document.querySelector('[data-rpg="camera"][data-id="follow"]').click();Realm.test.view({yaw:.4,elevation:.67,half:14});const d=Realm.diagnostics.adventure,actor=d.enemies.find(a=>a.id===RealmEarthExpedition.patrol.id+'-run-3-root');if(!actor||actor.hp<=0||d.tactics.auto||Realm.state.adventure.hp<=0)throw Error('Expected same live root encounter and surviving traveler');return{actor,hp:Realm.state.adventure.hp,method:'Same actual encounter continues with autoattack off; no HP refill, scaling or simulation acceleration'};}
